## Task: Calculate the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain regions in human, pig and mouse.

```{r}
human_elevated <- sum(180,83,57,110)
pig_elevated <- sum(109,157,51,45)
mouse_elevated <- sum(55,185,60,98)
print(paste("total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain in humans is", human_elevated))
print(paste("total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain in humans is",pig_elevated))
print(paste("total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain in humans is",mouse_elevated))
```

### Conclusion

[**Humans** had the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression.]{.mark}
